title: W3C Web Cryptography Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Cryptography Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/deriveKey

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Parameters > keyUsages

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The parameter derivedKeyAlgorithm was renamed to derivedKeyType in #41112, but this reference was missed:

Note that the key usages must be allowed by the algorithm set in derivedKeyAlgorithm.

What did you expect to see?

The parameter name in the note should be derivedKeyType instead of derivedKeyAlgorithm, matching the current syntax definition:

Note that the key usages must be allowed by the algorithm set in derivedKeyType.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

  • #41112

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
